content_of_post_to_comment: What is one Christian book that changed how you actually live? Not simply a book you admired. A book that changed a habit, practice, relationship, or way of seeing God. Drop the title and one sentence about what it changed. My answer will probably involve Dallas Willard.
comment: A book that changes life often doesn't just add beliefs; it reshapes the practices that make those beliefs tangible. The interesting question is whether formation happens more through ideas or repeated habits.
